rps.description: Maximum requests per second for the tenant

tokens_per_min.description: Maximum LLM tokens per minute for the tenant

burst_pct.description: Token bucket capacity as a percent of tokens_per_min; 0 uses the server default

model_limits.description: Per-model token quotas for the tenant

model.description: Model name the quota applies to

tokens_per_min.description: Maximum LLM tokens per minute for this tenant and model; 0 removes the model quota

items.description: A nonempty model is required by the handler despite the schema's optional property. Storage rejects '|' in tenant/model names. Zero, including an omitted tokens_per_min, removes the model quota. Negative values currently also remove it; that is not an approved negative-quota policy. Repeated model entries are applied in order, with the last successful write winning.

priority_class.description: The highest priority class a request of this tenant may have: standard, critical or sheddable. Omitted leaves the stored value; an empty string clears it, and a tenant that sets no class is held at standard.

default_objective.description: The objective a request of this tenant gets when it names none, or one it may not use. Omitted leaves the stored value; an empty string clears it.

allowed_objectives.description: The objectives a request of this tenant may raise itself to with the x-llm-d-inference-objective header, and the body tiers it may raise itself to by service_tier, named tier:priority, tier:fast and tier:flex; at most 64. Omitted leaves the stored list; an empty array clears it, and then only a hint at or below what the request gets without one is honoured (the list governs raises only).
